subject: R Workshop (BSP), Session 2 (30 July) — Capacity Limit and Venue Power
notes: Formal notice to Dr. Rowena R. Antemano (host of the Balik Scientist Program) and the Chair of Biological Sciences, sent at Dr. Forteza's direction with her copied, that Session 2 on 30 July will not accept walk-in participants. Sets out the capacity constraints — a Terms of Reference ceiling of 20, a room furnished for at most 30, and 70 registrations against it — records the loss of mains power during Session 1, and requests confirmation of the venue's power arrangements for 30 July. Offers those who cannot be accommodated a formal channel to request additional sessions through Dr. Antemano. This email was sent by hand.
